name: IQFAntiBotHook
mechanic: Launch protection: allowlist-only swaps and size caps during an anti-snipe window.
plain: Protects IQF/USDT launches with time-based phases. During the opening anti-snipe window only allowlisted addresses can swap, under per-transaction size caps and per-address limits, easing as the phases advance.
rules: The opening phase allows only allowlisted addresses to swap.
Per-transaction and per-address size caps apply until the window ends.
